name: Canned Yellow Cling Peaches in 100% Juice or Water
whyItWorks: Peeled and steam-softened canned peaches provide smooth hydration, vitamin C, and gentle soluble fiber without the harsh fuzzy skin that causes mechanical irritation in Crohn's and Colitis.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain excess packing liquid and eat the soft peach slices. Excellent paired with plain white rice, oatmeal, or plain lactose-free yogurt.
watchOuts: Always verify that skins have been completely removed during processing.
